# Stale sources — do not edit

These files were the original sources for
`articles/data-engineering-interview-prep.html` and stopped being maintained in
April 2026. Parts 10–12 and the 2026 upgrade (Parts 13–20, interview cards,
drills, corrected claims) exist only in the article.

Edit the article directly, then run `python scripts/handbook_build.py` and
`python scripts/check_handbook.py`. `scripts/combine_interview.py` is retired and
refuses to run. (`Netflix_L5_Companion_PaddySpeaks.html` is a separate page and is
unaffected.)
